title: archangel config
description: The elements of a repository, named sets of its files, and the rules between them. Archangel checks the same fields, with every problem at once.

$schema.description: This schema, for editors; archangel ignores it.

parts.description: The parts of the code, by file pattern. A file is in one part at most.

oneOf.description: A path pattern; `{name}` captures one instance, such as one feature.
Several path patterns.

elements.description: The elements: parts of the code by file pattern, or packages, by name.

oneOf.description: A path pattern; `{name}` captures one instance, such as one feature.
Several path patterns.

packages.description: Package names; a name may end in `*`.

groups.description: The same as `selectors`: named sets of files, which may overlap.

selectors.description: Named sets of files, which rules and other selectors use by name. A selector's name may not be an element's.

externals.description: Named lists of outside packages, such as `pg`, `@aws-sdk/*` or `node:fs`.

additionalProperties.description: Package names. A package is in every set that lists it.

rules.description: The rules: a shorthand with `kind`, or a sentence of `files` and one condition.

oneOf.description: Each listed element may import only itself and later listed elements.

name.description: The rule's name, for exceptions and the baseline; each rule gives a default.

reason.description: Why the rule exists, shown with each violation.

because.description: The same as `reason`: why the rule exists. A rule has one of the two.

link.description: Where to read more, shown with each violation.

imports.description: Which imports the rule checks: all of them, those that stay at runtime, or type imports.

order.description: Each listed element may import only itself and later listed elements.

imports.description: Which imports the rule checks: all of them, those that stay at runtime, or type imports.

noCycles.description: The files may not import each other in a cycle.

oneOf.description: A rule of several sentences, broken when any of them is. Each sentence takes `files` or `folders` and one condition, and leaves the name, reason, link, imports and examples to the rule.

name.description: The rule's name, for exceptions and the baseline; a rule of several sentences has no default.

reason.description: Why the rule exists, shown with each violation.

because.description: The same as `reason`: why the rule exists. A rule has one of the two.

link.description: Where to read more, shown with each violation.

imports.description: Which imports the rule's import sentences check: all of them, those that stay at runtime, or type imports.

items.description: A sentence: `files` or `folders`, and one condition with its options.

sentences.description: The sentences, each of which the rule's files must keep.

ignore.description: Lines in `.gitignore` syntax that remove files from the check.

allowUnresolved.description: Specifiers that may stay unresolved, each with the reason; a specifier may end in `*`.

plugins.description: The plugins a TypeScript or JavaScript config loads, by the name its rules use them by. A plugin is code, so a JSON config cannot load one.

extends.description: The presets a TypeScript or JavaScript config extends, such as `fsd({ root: 'src' })`. A preset is a function, so a JSON config cannot use one.

off.description: Rule names to turn off after the presets are merged, such as `fsd/insignificant-slice`; a name that matches no rule is an error.

exampleFiles.description: Files by path, relative to the config folder, with their text.

examples.description: File sets the rule must accept and must reject, which `archangel test` checks.

selector.description: Files: an element or selector by name, a path pattern with a `/` or a `*`, a list of these (any of them), or one combination.

all.description: The files in every one of these.

any.description: The files in any one of these.

element.description: The files of this element of files, or of any element for `*`.

capture.description: One instance of the element, by its captures, such as `{ "feature": "login" }`.

directive.description: The files that start with this directive, such as `use client`.

packages.description: Packages by name; a name may end in `*`, and `*` is every package.

side.description: The other side of an import condition: an element or selector by name, a path pattern, `{ "packages": [...] }`, a combination, or a list of these.

style.description: A way of writing the words of a name.

namePattern.description: A name: text, `*` for any text, and `{FileName}`, `{fileName}`, `{file-name}`, `{file_name}` or `{FILE_NAME}` for the file's name in each style, or the same spellings of `{FolderName}` for the name of the folder that holds it.
